thesis: ASO is in a strong uptrend (close 69.28 above SMA20 66.56, SMA50 58.37 and SMA200 53.47, RS 0.68) and is consolidating on light volume. It is in XLY, one of the few sectors with positive 21-day returns in a risk-off tape. Profitability is solid and multiples are low (forward P/E 9.79), and the 67.80-69.30 pullback zone with a 66.70 stop gives about 2.8 reward/risk to the 73.8 high. This is a tactical, limit-only trade: the pre-market indication of 71.36 is above the zone, where reward/risk to 73.8 against a 66.70 stop is about 0.5, so it must not be chased. The position has to be exited before the 2026-12-08 earnings report.
invalidation: A daily close below 66.70 (under the 66.96 swing low and the SMA20 near 66.6), or a failed retest of 73.82 followed by lower closes.
key_risks: Earnings on 2026-12-08 fall 9 trading days out. Exit by the 2026-12-07 close; a gap can skip the 66.70 stop
